lines.text: باشد و کثرت موت (واگر در حوت بود) دلالت کند بر صلح میان ملوك وسلاطین
lines.en: and there will be an abundance of death. (And if it is in Pisces) it indicates peace between kings and sultans,

lines.text: و فرماندهان وسلامتی اهل بلاد وقراء وکثرت امطار نافعه وبسیاری زراعت و
lines.en: and commanders, and the safety of the people of the cities and villages, and an abundance of beneficial rains, and much agriculture, and

lines.text: نیکی ارتفاعات ومحصولات وکثرت گیاه خاصه در هبوب ریاح جیده وامن وقرار
lines.en: the goodness of crops and harvests, and an abundance of grass, especially in the blowing of good winds, and security and stability

lines.text: خاطرها ورونق جمعیتها خاصه در میان اکابر واعاظم وفراخی نعمت وکثرت خیرات
lines.en: of minds, and the flourishing of gatherings, especially among the great and the eminent, and the abundance of blessings, and the multitude of good deeds,

lines.text: وطغیان ابها وسلامتی کشتیها وفرو نشستن اشوب ورفع نزاعها ورونق ارباب
lines.en: and the overflowing of waters, and the safety of ships, and the subsiding of turmoil, and the removal of disputes, and the flourishing of the masters

lines.text: ووقوع نکاحهای خیر وشادی علما وقضاة وصلاح حال ارباب ملاهی ومناهی و
lines.en: and the occurrence of good marriages, and the joy of scholars and judges, and the improvement of the condition of the masters of amusements and forbidden things, and

lines.text: رغبت مردم بعلوم واگر مشتری مستعلی باشد سلامتی خلایق بود وبسیاری مرغ وماهی
lines.en: the inclination of people to sciences. And if Jupiter is elevated, there will be safety for the creatures, and many birds and fish,

lines.text: وخوف زنان حامله واگر زهره مستعلی باشد وانواع فتنه بود در موصل وموت زنان
lines.en: and fear for pregnant women. And if Venus is elevated, there will be various seditions in Mosul, and the death of women,

lines.text: وکثرت باران واگر این قران نزديك اول سال یا انتقال دور یا فصل یا اواخر قران علویین
lines.en: and an abundance of rain. And if this conjunction is near the beginning of the year, or the transfer of the cycle, or the season, or the end of the conjunction of the two superiors,

lines.text: اتفاق افتد تاثیرت نيك از امن واسایش خلایق وعدل پادشاهی وفراخی وارزانی و
lines.en: it happens, good effects of security and comfort of the creatures, and the justice of the king, and abundance and cheapness, and

lines.text: مانند ان بسیار دهد چه حکما در ان باب مبالغه بسیار کرده اند (قران عطارد با مشتری
lines.en: the like of that will be given much, for the sages have exaggerated much in that chapter. (The conjunction of Mercury with Jupiter

lines.text: در مثلثات اربع) قران عطارد ومشتری مطلقا دلیل بود بر حرکت هوا وحدوث ریاح
lines.en: in the four triplicities) The conjunction of Mercury and Jupiter absolutely is an indication of the movement of the air and the occurrence of winds,

lines.text: وشدت وضعف او بقدر اتصال کواکب اماکن قران باشد چنانکه بر زیرك مخفی نیست
lines.en: and its strength and weakness are according to the connection of the planets of the places of the conjunction, as is not hidden to the astute.

lines.text: وایتم دلالت کند بر مناظرهها میان علما وحکما وطلب اسرار علوم وامانت وراستی
lines.en: And also it indicates debates among scholars and philosophers, and the seeking of the secrets of sciences, and trustworthiness and honesty,

lines.text: ونیکی حال صناع پس اگر مشتری قوی حال ومستعلی باشد دلالت کند بر قوت حال بزرگان
lines.en: and the goodness of the condition of artisans. So if Jupiter is strong in condition and elevated, it indicates the strength of the condition of the great,

lines.text: وتمشیت دادن کارها بر قوانین عدل وبسیاری خیر وایمنی راهها وفراخی طعام واگر
lines.en: and the management of affairs according to the laws of justice, and much good, and the safety of roads, and the abundance of food. And if

lines.text: عطارد قوی وغالب باشد دلالت کند بر راستی خلایق واهل دیوان وبجا رو گفتن
lines.en: Mercury is strong and dominant, it indicates the honesty of the creatures and the people of the divan, and speaking appropriately,

lines.text: سخنان حق وبسیاری تحصیل علوم وامدن اخبار صحیحه ورونق بازارها وبالجمله
lines.en: words of truth, and much acquisition of sciences, and the coming of correct news, and the flourishing of markets, and in short,

lines.text: امتزاج این دو کوکب دلیل بادها معتدل بود ووضع قوانین درست وراست وامن و
lines.en: the mixture of these two planets is an indication of moderate winds, and the establishment of correct and straight laws, and security and

lines.text: فراخی وموافقت مردم بایکدیگر (قران مشتری وعطارد در مثلثه اتشی) دلالت کند
lines.en: abundance, and the agreement of people with each other. (The conjunction of Jupiter and Mercury in the fiery triplicity) indicates

lines.text: بر رونق کار ضرابان وصائغان وصرافان ومستوفیان ودبیران ومتصرفان وتجار
lines.en: the flourishing of the work of minters, and goldsmiths, and money changers, and accountants, and secretaries, and administrators, and merchants,

lines.text: وراستی وامانت در این طایفه وامدن کاروانها وبسیاری بیع جواهر ووقوع اخبار
lines.en: and honesty and trustworthiness in this group, and the coming of caravans, and much selling of jewels, and the occurrence of news

lines.text: خوش ونوشتن خطها ومثالها وبیع وشری با نفع وارزانی وبصواب امدن احکام
lines.en: good, and the writing of scripts and examples, and buying and selling with profit and cheapness, and the coming to correctness of judgments

summary.headline: Mercury–Jupiter Conjunction Omens
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Mercury and Jupiter in Pisces and across the four triplicities, including effects on rain, agriculture, peace, trade, scholarship, law, winds, and public safety. The fiery triplicity is associated with minters, goldsmiths, money changers, accountants, secretaries, administrators, merchants, caravans, jewels, and profitable commerce, with variant omens when Jupiter or Venus is elevated.
